ios.desc:
Ensō is a sleek, elegant meditation timer and bell, designed to get out of your way so you can focus on what matters most: your practice. No clutter. No noise. No pressure.

The timer, your stats, and a gorgeous-sounding default bell cost nothing. They're free and ad-free, forever.

Ensō never locks you into its own content. Already have a guided session you love? Play it. Prefer your own music, or pure silence? Ensō fits around your practice, not the other way around.

What people say about Ensō:

"Considering the quality and utility of this app, Ensō is a godsend for meditation lovers" — Lifehacker.ru

"For a distraction free meditation experience that lets you customize intervals and timers, you want Ensō." — iMore.com

"This is the best meditation app I've ever used by far. It has just enough features, but isn't cluttered. It makes me excited to meditate again!"

"Elegant design, simple, and the many bell sounds are terrific. A great app that doesn't over complicate something that shouldn't be over complicated!"

"I've been meditating regularly for over 25 years. I wish I'd had this app a long time ago! Thanks Enso!"

Meditation is a wonderful way to ease stress, quiet anxiety, and find inner calm. Ensō gently guides each session and quietly tracks your progress, helping you make mindfulness part of your daily routine.

Ensō offers, free:

- An easy-to-use, beautifully simple meditation timer
- High-quality, professionally recorded bells and bowls to start and end your session
- A preparation timer to settle in before you begin
- An interval timer and bell to keep you gently oriented in time
- An at-a-glance progress indicator during your sit
- Progress reports and streaks to keep you motivated
- Screen-off support for walking meditation (use the side button)
- Distraction-free chiming, even when your device is set to silent

Ensō Plus

Unlock everything Ensō has to offer. Plus is available as a yearly subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase, whichever suits you.

With Ensō Plus you get:

- All 11 additional bells: ceremonial bells, singing bowls, gongs and more
- Reminders to schedule your sessions, with 12 alert chimes crafted exclusively for Ensō
- Presets: save your favorite setups and let Intelligent Presets activate them automatically
- In-session audio: play your own music or a guided meditation while you sit
- Apple Health Integration: log every session as mindful minutes

quotes.text:
I've used the Calm app for the introduction course to learn about how to meditate and start with guidance, then I continued on my own. Paying 10$ monthly for sitting still is hilarious. IMHO the quantity of these kind of  apps, guides and whatnot simply offer a paradox of choice, which is ironic, since the user wants to relax, not obsess if he bought the right app, subscription and/or meditation technique.

I now use Enso app [1] just to alert the 15 min duration, it's free on the App Store (optional purchases for different alert bells).

[1] https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/enso-meditation-timer-bell/id840637879?mt=8
quotes.story_title: How to Pick a Meditation App
